# Geometry · Vectors

> **7 laws held out of 7**

## Algebraic structure

<a id="Vectors"></a>

### Vectors

`Vectors` · `src/vectors.ts:50` · status: **held**

Points and directions in three dimensions: added, subtracted, scaled, multiplied (the dot product, the cross product), measured, mixed; the angle between two directions and at a point, a direction on the floor from its angle. A direction shorter than the tolerance has none: its unit is the origin.

The operations are written in `./code/vectors.ts`.

| Law | Checked |
|---|---|
| Adding is commutative and associative, the origin adds nothing, the difference undoes it | held on 100 draws |
| The dot product is symmetric, distributes over addition, and gives a vector's length squared | held on 100 draws |
| The cross product is perpendicular to both its factors, and changes sign when they swap | held on 100 draws |
| A unit has a length of one and the direction it came from, or is the origin when there was none | held on 100 draws |
| A direction makes no angle with itself, a half turn with its opposite, a quarter turn with what it crosses | held on 100 draws |
| The axes are right-handed, and forward turned by a quarter turn on the floor is left | held on 100 draws |
| Mixing goes from the first at none of the way to the second at all of it, through their middle | held on 100 draws |

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `none` | `0` | The coordinate of the origin along each axis: no distance |

- Owner: ghalaax
- Parameters: `axes` ← [The axes](#Axes) · `tolerance` ← [The tolerance](#Tolerance) · `angles` ← [Angle](angles.md#Angle)
- Serves: [Geometry written once](product.md#GeometryWrittenOnce)

## Decisions

<a id="Axes"></a>

### The axes

`Axes` · `src/vectors.ts:18`

Which way each coordinate points: the first along the floor, forward; the second along the floor, to the left; the third up, so that the floor is where the third is zero. Right-handed: forward crossed with left is up.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| forward | 1, 0, 0 |
| left | 0, 1, 0 |
| up | 0, 0, 1 |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Rejected: Up as the second axis, as three.js has it, a body on the floor would be measured by its depth; a drawing turns the axes at its own edge; Left-handed axes, the cross product would point down, and every rule that turns a direction would change sign
- Used by: [Vectors](#Vectors)

<a id="Tolerance"></a>

### The tolerance

`Tolerance` · `src/vectors.ts:32`

How far apart two points may be and still be the same, in metres: a micrometre, far below what a body or a drawing shows, far above what rounding leaves after a computation. A direction shorter than that has none.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| length | 0 |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Rejected: Exact equality, a point computed two ways differs in its last digits; A millimetre, two hands a millimetre apart would be one, which a figure drawn close up shows
- Used by: [Vectors](#Vectors)

## Architecture decision

<a id="VectorsAsTriples"></a>

### A vector is three numbers

`VectorsAsTriples` · `src/vectors.ts:122` · status: **held**

A point or a direction is a triple of numbers, and what is done with it is a structure's operation: written once, with its laws, rather than as helpers each product writes again.

Context: Poselia's body computed with vectors through helpers written beside its rules, and its angles as numbers of degrees: the next product drawing or moving something would have written them again, and a degree passed where a radian was expected would have been seen by nobody.

Consequences: A point, a direction, a key of a pose is a Vector: frozen into a program as it is, compared within the tolerance. A rule receives Vectors as a dependency and calls its operations; an angle is a quantity, written in the unit it is thought in (deg(30), turns(0.25)).

| Rejected | Why |
|---|---|
| A class with methods | a value of the graph must be data, which a program carries frozen and a document shows |
| three.js's Vector3 | the rules of a body would depend on the library that draws it |
| Angles as numbers of degrees | a computation in radians and a value in degrees would mix without a word |

- Decided by: ghalaax
- Serves: [Geometry written once](product.md#GeometryWrittenOnce)
- Applied by: [Vectors](#Vectors), [Angle](angles.md#Angle)
